_comment: Which canvas input ports feed each Pika request field, in priority order.
This is the ONLY hand-maintained table in the model layer. Everything else
(params, defaults, pricing, required-ness) is generated from the public
catalog by scripts/sync-catalog.mjs. The table is keyed by request-field
name rather than by model, because Pika reuses ~17 field names across all
109 endpoints — so one entry here covers every model that uses it.
sync-catalog.mjs FAILS if the catalog introduces a field name that is not
listed here. That is deliberate: an unmapped field would silently receive
nothing, and the user would pay for a generation that ignored their inputs.
For a single-valued field the first connected port with a matching kind
wins. For an array field every listed port contributes, in order.

A field is normally a list of ports. A TAGGED-UNION array (Kling 3.0's `contents`) instead maps each port to the role string the item must carry, because there the port IS the semantics: the same URL means first frame or reference or base clip depending on where it is wired.
